<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Block Minimap demo
 * Description: Opens the Block Minimap sidebar when the editor loads.
 */

add_action(
	'enqueue_block_editor_assets',
	function () {
		wp_add_inline_script(
			'wp-edit-post',
			"wp.domReady( function () {
				var area = 'block-minimap/block-minimap';
				var unsubscribe = function () {};
				var openMinimap = function () {
					var active = wp.data.select( 'core/interface' ).getActiveComplementaryArea( 'core' );
					if ( ! active ) {
						return false;
					}
					unsubscribe();
					if ( active !== area ) {
						wp.data.dispatch( 'core/interface' ).enableComplementaryArea( 'core', area );
					}
					return true;
				};
				// Wait for the editor to open its first sidebar, unless it already has.
				if ( ! openMinimap() ) {
					unsubscribe = wp.data.subscribe( openMinimap );
				}
			} );"
		);
	}
);
